info.title: nb1 local API v1
info.description: Implementation contract for the source checkout identified by x-source. The installed local runtime has its own version and validation state. The 14 API capabilities occupy 15 HTTP operations because the valid saved-color name resolve also has a concrete PUT path. All example devices are virtual. JSON request bodies are bounded to 1 MiB. The runtime rejects duplicate fields, unknown fields, explicit null, invalid Unicode, and unsupported number spellings. Cross-field execution budgets are validated by the core.

x-access.browser_origin: same origin or a non-browser client without Origin

x-runtime-validation.number_spelling: Integer tokens reject fractions and exponent notation. Action and RGB8 integer fields require unsigned digit tokens. Sequence integer fields accept JSON -0 where zero is within the numeric bounds. HSV accepts unsigned ordinary decimals with at most six fractional digits. JSON Schema validates mathematical values and cannot distinguish all these token spellings.
cross_field_constraints: interval targets match initial target LED count and order

post.description: The device must be idle and support the compiled Sequence. The daemon owns timing after admission. A lost HTTP response or client timeout can leave an accepted Job running. Query the original ID. Retained matching IDs replay before resolving mutable color or Pattern references. A changed source or serial conflicts. Terminal records use a 16,384-entry LRU and expire at a fixed time up to 30 minutes after completion. Active Jobs stay pinned. Cache pressure evicts terminal records and does not reject new execution. After expiration or eviction the same ID can execute again.

Serial.description: Explicit configured device serial. Examples use a virtual device.

JobIDInput.description: Omit or send an empty string to generate j_ plus ten random Crockford Base32 characters. Preserve the chosen ID when an execution response is lost.

ExactColor.description: Exact raw RGB execution target. Input permits either hex case.

ColorText.description: ASCII Hex3, Hex6 or one of the 148 fixed opaque CSS names, case-insensitive. Leading and trailing ASCII whitespace is accepted. The decoded string is at most 64 bytes.

ColorAlias.description: A local saved color reference. The daemon resolves it for new Actions and saves the resulting exact RGB in Patterns.
